explanation: He built it for Mumtaz Mahal, who died in 1631. Deposed by his son Aurangzeb, he spent his last years confined in Agra Fort, within sight of it.

claims.text: The Mughal emperor Shah Jahan built the Taj Mahal as a tomb for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
Akbar, Aurangzeb and Babur did not build the Taj Mahal.
Shah Jahan was deposed by his son Aurangzeb and confined in Agra Fort for the rest of his life.
The Taj Mahal can be seen from Agra Fort.
